data.body: `make verify` on the amended commit (`9b673e307f9`): lint, typecheck and the import-convention guard pass; default tier **20,360 passed, 27 skipped, 0 failed**; integration tier **202 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed**: `tests/integration/test_s3_doctor.py::test_git_remote_s3_api_surface_contract`, `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named git_remote_s3`. It is independent of this change (the diff touches only `_store/sync.py`, `_store/git_outcome.py` and `tests/unit/test_sync_union_recovery.py`): the test skips on a `git-remote-s3` binary on PATH (this host has one in `~/.local/bin`) but imports the package from the venv, which `make install` does not give the `[s3]` extra. Neither of the two allowed host failures in the AC covers it (both are now closed). Filed as `dominating-effete-bat` (discovered_from). So `make verify` exited 2, not 0.
